physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the lymphatic system, the body's quiet underworld of clear fluid that moves without a pump, draining what is finished from the tissues and feeding the spleen, where the immune intelligence sits and listens. It is fitting. The well is a body of water under the ground. The lymph is a body of water under the skin. Both work in the dark, both move slowly, both decide what stays and what is carried away, and the wisdom of either is invisible until it falters.

The shadow has its floor here. The bodily form of inadequacy is congestion, a swampy heaviness in the soft places, a sense that what should drain is sitting still. The body has been bracing for so long that the channels have gone sluggish. The mind reads it as not-enough; the tissues are telling the same truth in their own language.

The climb out is bodily too. The lymph only moves when you breathe deep, when you walk, when something other than thinking takes over. Movement returns first, and then clarity at the throat and the gut and behind the eyes, and then the surprise the keys promised, the well not empty, the resource already in the room. The code is fluid before it is thought. It runs in the part of you that listens by sensing what is no longer needed and quietly carrying it out.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Alanine. Alanine is one of the small set the body builds for itself, made on the spot from what is already at hand, traded back and forth between muscle and liver when the work runs long. It is not exotic. It is the chemistry of staying available, of having something to draw on when the day asks more than the day brought.

There is a teaching in that, and it sits closer to the bone than any reading. The code of inadequacy and resourcefulness rests on a molecule whose whole job is to be produced as needed, lent out, recycled, made again. The body is already doing what the gift describes. The well is not a metaphor laid over the chemistry, it is the chemistry. Lower the bucket and something the body made from nothing in particular rises with it, exactly enough, no surplus to hoard. The code runs all the way to this: a resource that is made by being used.
